lines.text: You agree with it, and the coffee is still somewhere behind your teeth, and it did not save you, because it was only ever coffee with something kind in it.
He put something in it. A stimulant. To hold the thing off, to buy me the night.
A guard on a gate read a work order for a building that eats recordists, and he did the one thing a man in a booth can do — he made you a hot drink and he hoped.
It was real. He tried. And I still said her name.
